releases.notes: # Rotten Flesh to Leather - RFTL ## Description This mod adds Cooked Rotten Meat, which is obtained by smelting Rotten Meat. Five Cooked Rotten Meats can be placed on a crafting table to obtain leather. The idea of the 5:1 ratio is to be able to get leather but maintaining some "difficulty" in the process. ## Recipes Convert Rotten Flesh to Cooked Rotten Flesh by smelting it in a furnace. Then craft one leather by placing five pieces of Cooked Rotten Flesh (One in each corner and one in the center). ## Versions ### 1.0.0 - Initial release. Adds one item and two recipes to convert Rotten Flesh into Leather.
